sources.title: Exact tagged repository question and Batch 0033 frozen source boundary
Point-to-infinite-line deterministic C++20 validation against independent general-form oracle

claims.text: The repository source preserves only a 2D point-to-line C++ coding task; line representation, API, numeric policy, degenerate behavior, precision and line-vs-segment details are not preserved source constraints.
Under the explicit answer-side contract of an infinite line through two distinct points, the exact compiled C++20 implementation returns abs(cross(B-A,P-A))/|B-A| and rejects A==B.
The fixture passes five fixed geometry cases, degenerate rejection, endpoint-order invariance, non-negativity, and 5,000 deterministic random cases against an independent Ax+By+C oracle.
